name: Java Tools
author: NPad++ Community
summary: Wrap code in a main method or try/catch, generate getters/setters and records from fields.
documentation: Select statements and wrap them in public static void main or try/catch. Select field declarations such as "private String name;" and generate getters and setters (boolean fields get isX, final fields get no setter) or a record. The class or record name comes from the file name.
